# Algebraic Factorization（代数因式分解）

### 1. Exponent Rule

$$
a^n b^n = (ab)^n
$$

### 2. Difference of Powers

$$
a^n - b^n = (a - b)(a^{n-1} + a^{n-2}b + \dots + b^{n-1})
$$

### 3. Special Case

$$
x^n - 1 = (x - 1)(x^{n-1} + \dots + x + 1)
$$

### 4. Trigger

$$
a^n - b^n \text{ or } x^n - 1 \implies \text{Try factorization.}
$$
